analysis.summary: Accent Microcell Limited reported a 31.92% year-on-year growth in revenue from operations to ₹34,903.28 Lakhs for FY26. The company is expanding its total installed capacity from 9,200 MTPA to 12,000 MTPA through its Unit-III facility, which will manufacture premium excipients. Although the implementation timeline for Unit-III has been re-aligned due to abnormal monsoons and regulatory delays, the company is progressing steadily toward trial runs and expects the unit to generate ₹70 crore in revenue in its first year. Accent Microcell Limited held an investor call on August 7, 2025, to discuss operational progress, industry demand, and expansion plans. Management highlighted that global demand for microcrystalline cellulose (MCC) remains steady, with increased product inquiries following an incident at a peer's plant.

guidance.claim: Unit-III is projected to generate ₹70 crore in revenue in its first year of operations.
The projected revenue mix for Unit-III is 60% exports and 40% domestic sales.
The company expects a revenue CAGR of 15% to 20% over the next 3 to 5 years.
guidance.quote: Just a moment, sir, at least say 15 to 20% CAGR for next 3 to 5 years. We are expecting.

guidance.claim: Unit 3 Phase 1 is expected to operate at around 60% capacity utilization in its first year.
guidance.quote: from current fiscal given a full year capacity, we are expecting it to be utility level, to be around 60% for the 1st year.

guidance.claim: Unit 3 Phase 2 is expected to achieve around 50% to 55% capacity utilization in its launch financial year.
guidance.quote: roughly, the capacity will be around 50 to 55 percentage for that particular financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Product inquiries have increased following an incident at a competitor's manufacturing facility.
demand_outlook.quote: of course is, there has been product. Inquiry has been increased, and we have been taking care of the business from our business side.

demand_outlook.claim: Global MCC industry demand is expected to see a 1% to 1.5% boost over its base growth rate of 5% to 6%.
demand_outlook.quote: So for current scenario, of course, as I mentioned earlier, that it's positive impact. By 1.1 point 5% extra.

demand_outlook.claim: Total annual global market demand for MCC is estimated at 2,50,000 metric tons, while Indian market demand is 50,000 metric tons.
demand_outlook.quote: We have 2.5 lakh is globally 50,000 metric ton for the Indian market.

demand_outlook.claim: Long-term contracts account for 10% to 15% of global sales, with the remainder sold on a spot basis.
demand_outlook.quote: 10 to 15% contracts we are having globally rest are on a freehand basis or open contract basis.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capital expenditure for Unit 3 excluding land is estimated between Rs 105 crore and Rs 110 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: it will be anywhere between 105 to 110 cr.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial operations for Unit 3 Phase 1 are scheduled to begin by late October or early November 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: So anywhere between, say by the end of October or in the 1st couple of weeks of November.

capex_expansion.claim: Trial runs for Unit 3 Phase 2 are expected to commence in July 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Sir, we're expecting it to be in the month of say, July 2,026.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure for Unit 3 Phase 2 is estimated at Rs 55 crore to Rs 60 crore excluding land.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, sir, it is around 55 to 60 crore, except the value of land.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA margin was 18.18% in FY26 compared to 18.26% in FY25.
Accent Microcell previously achieved EBITDA margins around 16% and targets 20% to 22% post expansion.
margins_costs.quote: Sir EBITDA margin was around 16% going ahead as we are coming out with unique 3 in phase, manner, that is phase one and phase 2.

margins_costs.claim: Croscarmellose Sodium (CCS) commands a selling price around 3.5 times higher than Microcrystalline Cellulose (MCC).
margins_costs.quote: The price of CC. CCS is around 3.5 times of MCC.

margins_costs.claim: MCC realization stands at around Rs 230 per kg for export markets and Rs 180 per kg for domestic markets.
margins_costs.quote: Sir. For export markets around 2 30 per kg. And for domestic is around 1 80 per kg.

margins_costs.claim: The company earns net profit margins of 5% to 7% on traded volumes.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, it is not. It is not on a lower side, at least. It is around 5 to 7 percentage.

Unit II in Dahej SEZ has an installed capacity of 7,200 MTPA.
The company has 4 to 5 months of business orders currently on hand.

orders_capacity.quote: 9,600 is our current capacity, so our phase? One, is about 2,400.

orders_capacity.claim: Unit 3 Phase 1 will add 2,400 metric tons per annum of premium excipients, and Phase 2 will add 12,000 metric tons per annum of MCC.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, sir, phase one at 100% capacity utilization. It will be around 2,400 metric ton per annum and phase 2 will be 12,000 metric ton

orders_capacity.claim: Total annual capacity across all units will reach 24,000 metric tons per annum after Phase 2.
orders_capacity.quote: So it will. Total will be 24,000 metric ton per annum.

capital_allocation.quote: Apart from that. Just to be clear for the fund raising that what you have done for the right issue. It is around 40 crores, and the total cost of phase 2 will be around roughly between 55 to 60 crores.

risks_headwinds.quote: the approvals are somewhere around 6 months to one year in the Pharma MNCs. And in some of the MNCs of a bit higher range. It will be somewhere around 2 years.
